lessons.title: Ancient India - Indus Valley
lessons.content:
# Ancient India - Indus Valley

## Indus Valley Civilization (3300-1300 BCE)

One of the **oldest civilizations** in the world!

## Major Cities

### 1. Harappa (Punjab, Pakistan)
- Discovered in 1921
- Well-planned streets
- Great Granary

### 2. Mohenjo-Daro (Sindh, Pakistan)
- Discovered in 1922
- Great Bath
- Advanced drainage system

## Achievements
- 🏙️ Town planning with grid system
- 💧 Underground drainage
- 📝 Indus script (still undeciphered)
- ⚖️ Standard weights and measures
- 🌾 Agriculture: wheat, barley, cotton

## Daily Life
- People were farmers and traders
- Used bronze tools
- Made pottery and jewelry
- Traded with Mesopotamia

**Our ancestors were brilliant!** 🏛️

lessons.title: Freedom Struggle
lessons.content:
# Indian Freedom Struggle

## Key Events

### 1857 - First War of Independence
- Also called Sepoy Mutiny
- Started in Meerut
- Mangal Pandey played key role

### 1885 - Indian National Congress
- Founded by A.O. Hume
- First session in Bombay

### 1919 - Jallianwala Bagh
- Massacre in Amritsar
- General Dyer ordered firing

### 1930 - Dandi March
- Led by Mahatma Gandhi
- Salt Satyagraha
- 24 days, 390 km march

### 1942 - Quit India Movement
- "Do or Die" slogan
- Mass protests across India

### 1947 - Independence
- August 15, 1947
- India becomes free! 🇮🇳

## Great Leaders
- Mahatma Gandhi
- Jawaharlal Nehru
- Sardar Patel
- Bhagat Singh

**Jai Hind!** 🇮🇳

lessons.title: Indian Heritage & Culture
lessons.content:
# Indian Heritage & Culture

## Diversity of India

India is known for **Unity in Diversity**!

## Festivals

### National Festivals
- 🇮🇳 Republic Day (Jan 26)
- 🇮🇳 Independence Day (Aug 15)
- 🇮🇳 Gandhi Jayanti (Oct 2)

### Religious Festivals
- 🪔 Diwali - Festival of Lights
- 🎨 Holi - Festival of Colors
- 🕌 Eid - Islamic festival
- 🎄 Christmas - Christian festival

## Classical Dances
- Bharatanatyam (Tamil Nadu)
- Kathak (North India)
- Kathakali (Kerala)
- Odissi (Odisha)

## Monuments
- 🏰 Taj Mahal (Agra)
- 🛕 Qutub Minar (Delhi)
- 🏯 Red Fort (Delhi)
- 🕉️ Konark Temple (Odisha)

## Food Diversity
- North: Roti, Dal, Paneer
- South: Dosa, Idli, Sambar
- East: Fish curry, Rice
- West: Dhokla, Vada Pav

**Proud to be Indian!** 🇮🇳
